Alice in Borderland is an overlooked gem that definitely proves itself a sleeper hit after its first season. The survival thriller follows slacker gamer Arisu (Kento Yamazaki) and his two close friends as they’re mysteriously transported to a deserted Tokyo and forced to play deadly games in order to survive.

Alice in Borderland is one of Netflix’s most underrated sci-fi works, and with its first season of deadly games, it delivered quite the hook for fans of the genre who are willing to give it a chance. After the show’s initial season, the series becomes far more powerful as it starts offering more emotional depth, danger, and questions that ensure viewers wonder about life and purpose. Alice in Borderland is absolutely a strong fit for this list because it truly improves by making its violence mean more, marking it a Netflix sleeper that definitely delivers better material after its first season.
